title: My Twin Brother Sold Our Dad's $245K Neon Collection For $90K. So I Watched Him Polish Them.
description: When my twin brother forged a bill of sale and sold our late father’s $245K neon sign collection for $90K, I thought I’d never see those signs again. Then I found them displayed in a roadside museum with a plaque crediting our dad, and I sued him for conversion. Now I own Broken Trust beer garden, and my brother is legally required to polish them every Saturday. #FamilyBetrayal #LegalRevenge #NeonSigns
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY INHERITANCE, NOW HE POLISHES MY NEON
pinned_comment: If you found out your own twin brother had forged a bill of sale and stolen your $245K neon sign collection, would you have sued him and opened a beer garden, or handled it completely differently? Share your story in the comments.
